briefdescription.para: Write content to a file, creating directories as needed.

parameterdescription.para: Optional content (default: empty file). Single-arg version creates empty file.

briefdescription.para: CFG-01: Resolver rejects oversized paths (> kMaxConfigPathBytes).
CFG-02: Resolver handles missing paths gracefully (no exists, no fallback).
CFG-03: Resolver handles empty paths gracefully.
CFG-04: Resolver prevents directory-traversal attacks (../, ..\).
CFG-05: Resolver handles paths with null bytes safely.
CFG-06: Resolver handles absolute vs. relative paths consistently.
CFG-07: Resolver handles special characters in paths safely (spaces, quotes, etc.).
CFG-08: Resolver enforces bounded fallback resolution attempts.
CFG-09: Validator rejects oversized config files (> kMaxConfigFileSizeBytes).
CFG-10: Validator rejects oversized schemas (> kMaxSchemaSizeBytes).
CFG-11: Validator detects and rejects circular schema references.
CFG-12: Validator enforces maximum nesting depth (kMaxConfigNestingDepth).
CFG-13: Validator enforces maximum config key count (kMaxConfigTopLevelKeys).
CFG-14: Validator rejects malformed JSON/YAML without crashing.
CFG-15: Validator enforces maximum value size (kMaxConfigValueBytes).
CFG-16: Validator prevents external $ref resolution (SSRF prevention).
CFG-17: Watcher respects polling interval bounds [kFileWatcherMinPollInterval, kFileWatcherMaxPollInterval].
CFG-18: Watcher detects file modifications within bounded latency.
CFG-19: Watcher handles file deletion gracefully (signals change, no crash).
CFG-20: Watcher prevents busy-wait by enforcing minimum poll interval.
CFG-21: Watcher handles concurrent modifications during watch window (eventual consistency).
CFG-22: Watcher operation timeout prevents indefinite blocking (kFileWatcherOperationTimeout).
CFG-23: Watcher handles permission denied errors gracefully (logs, signals error, no crash).
CFG-24: Watcher does not block main application threads (all I/O is async or threaded).
CFG-25: Encrypted-store uses AES-256-GCM for all stored values.
CFG-26: Encrypted-store enforces GCM authentication tag length (16 bytes).
CFG-27: Encrypted-store enforces GCM IV length (12 bytes, 96 bits).
CFG-28: Encrypted-store returns CONFIG_DECRYPTION_ERROR on auth tag verification failure.
CFG-29: Encrypted-store supports non-blocking key rotation.
CFG-30: Encrypted-store validates metadata before decryption (IV, nonce, length checks).
CFG-31: Encrypted-store secures old keys after rotation (zeroing after kMaxEncryptionKeyRotationHistorySize).
CFG-32: Encrypted-store does not support partial reads (entire value or failure).
Returns true when text contains needle as a substring.
